literal_meaning: টপটপ করে পড়ার শব্দানুকরণ (dripping sound imitation)
figurative_meaning_en: drop by drop (referring to tears falling steadily)
example_sentences_in_english: She was crying drop by drop.
The rain is falling drop by drop.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe steady dripping, often of tears in emotional contexts.
